section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1977
title: 7 Among the Union Territories the maximum volume of accidental deaths per lakh of population was registered in D. & N. Haveli (74.70) followed by Delhi (48.49) and the minimum in Lakshadweep (2.94). Out of nine U.Ts. four registered less volume of accidental deaths per lakh of population than the all-India average and these were Chandigarh, Mizoram, Arunachal Pradesh and Lakshadweep. Among the Metropolitan Cities the maximum volume of accidental deaths per lakh of population was registered in Bombay (74.94) followed by Bangalore (50.85) and Delhi (48.72) and the minimum in Hyderabad (17.16). Out of eight Metropolitan Cities only Hyderabad city registered less volume of accidental deaths per lakh of population than the all-India average. The details are presented in Table II.
